title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on John 2: the wedding at Cana, the water become wine, and Jesus in the temple at the Passover.

questions.text: Where was the wedding that Jesus and his disciples were invited to?
questions.explanation: The third day there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee, and Jesus' mother was there.

questions.text: What did Jesus' mother tell the servants?
questions.explanation: When the wine ran out she told him, "They have no wine," and then said to the servants, "Whatever he says to you, do it."

answers.text: "Whatever he says to you, do it"
"Say nothing to the ruler of the feast"

questions.text: How many stone water pots were set there?
questions.explanation: There were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews' way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

questions.text: What did the ruler of the feast say to the bridegroom?
questions.explanation: Having tasted the water now become wine, the ruler of the feast told the bridegroom, "You have kept the good wine until now!"

answers.text: "You have kept the good wine until now!"
"Let the guests drink no more today"

questions.text: What does the chapter call what Jesus did in Cana of Galilee?
questions.explanation: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory, and his disciples believed in him.

answers.text: The second sign that he did
A work of the law of Moses

questions.text: What did Jesus make to drive the sellers out of the temple?
questions.explanation: He made a whip of cords and threw all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen, and poured out the changers' money and overthrew their tables.

questions.text: What did he say to those who sold the doves?
questions.explanation: He told them to take these things out of there, and not to make his Father's house a marketplace.

answers.text: "Don't make my Father's house a marketplace!"
"Give what you have gained to the poor"

questions.text: How long did the Jews say it had taken to build the temple?
questions.explanation: When Jesus said, "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up," the Jews said it had taken forty-six years to build the temple.

questions.text: What temple was Jesus speaking of?
questions.explanation: He spoke of the temple of his body, and when he was raised from the dead his disciples remembered that he had said this.

answers.text: The temple Moses built in the wilderness
A temple the Jews would build later

questions.text: Why did Jesus not entrust himself to those who believed at the feast?
questions.explanation: He did not entrust himself to them because he knew everyone, and did not need anyone to testify concerning man, for he himself knew what was in man.

answers.text: Because they had not seen any signs
Because he knew everyone and knew what was in man
Because the Passover was already over
